title: AgentFrontier raw-stream event
description: One raw-stream event: a canonical record (`body`) plus where it came from, what it is and how far it can be trusted. Implementations write the properties in the order listed here and omit optional properties whose value is unknown. Rules for eventId and nativeObjectId are in docs/envelope.md.

eventId.description: sha256: followed by 64 lower-case hex digits; deterministic, see docs/envelope.md

sourceSystemId.description: The connection id: one configured source system

connectorId.description: The definition that read it (postgresql, unity_catalog, ...)

op.description: upsert: the object exists with this body. delete: the source reported a deletion. tombstone: the object was not seen in a full run that should have seen it.

nativeObjectId.description: Stable id of the object inside its source system, see docs/envelope.md

nativeVersion.description: Source version of the object (ETag, generation, LSN, row version) when the source exposes one

observedAt.description: When AgentFrontier read it: UTC ISO-8601

eventTime.description: When it happened at the source, when the source says

schemaVersion.description: specVersion of entities.json the body follows

mappingVersion.description: Version of the definition or mapping profile that produced the body

assertion.description: observed: read from the source as it is. declared: the source states it (a declared lineage edge, a label set by a person). parsed: derived by parsing source artifacts (SQL, documents). inferred: proposed by a rule or model.

evidenceRef.description: Pointer to the evidence (query, API call, document span) behind the body

payloadRef.description: Pointer to the preserved raw payload, when raw payloads are kept

policyVersion.description: Version of the policy decision applied before release

body.description: The canonical record (record.schema.json): `entity`, `source`, level values, canonical fields and `properties`
